Regal Themes — Wedding Decor & Theme Design, Delhi-NCR

Regal Themes is a Delhi-NCR decorator known for fully themed weddings —
Bollywood, vintage, Rajasthani-royal, and fairytale concepts executed
end-to-end with props, lighting, and coordinated florals.

Their themed wedding decor packages start at ₹3,50,000 and scale to ₹12,00,000
for full multi-venue productions. They include concept design, fabrication, and
on-site execution.

Contact: +91 98185 60094 · design@regalthemes.example
Location: Saket, Delhi
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (133 reviews)
